nodes.name: Ingest Webhook
nodes.notes:
Receives POST from ingest_sorter.py --webhook or folder_watcher.py.
Payload: { mission_id, mission_number, package_type, photo_count, video_count, has_ppk_data, source_platform, mission_folder_path, ingested_at }

nodes.name: Lookup Processing Template
nodes.notes: Fetch processing template by package_type to determine which paths to run and vegetation config.

nodes.name: Build Routing Decision
nodes.notes: Determines which processing paths to run based on package type, file counts, and template config.

nodes.name: Update Job — Processing
nodes.notes: Mark job as processing, assign template, set vegetation flag, and set output_path.

nodes.name: Has Video?
nodes.notes: Route to video processing chain (V1-V6) if mission has video files.

parameters.command: =C:\Users\redle.SOULAAN\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python312\python.exe C:\Users\redle.SOULAAN\Documents\drone-pipeline\video_color_grade.py "{{ $('Build Routing Decision').item.json.mission_folder_path }}" --platform {{ $('Build Routing Decision').item.json.source_platform }} --mission-id {{ $('Build Routing Decision').item.json.mission_id }} --upload

nodes.name: V1 — Color Grade
nodes.notes: Applies Sentinel LUT via FFmpeg. First step of the video processing chain.

parameters.command: =C:\Users\redle.SOULAAN\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python312\python.exe C:\Users\redle.SOULAAN\Documents\drone-pipeline\video_metadata.py "{{ $('Build Routing Decision').item.json.mission_folder_path }}" --mission-id {{ $('Build Routing Decision').item.json.mission_id }} --platform {{ $('Build Routing Decision').item.json.source_platform }} --upload

nodes.name: V1.5 — Metadata
nodes.notes: Extracts video metadata via ffprobe and upserts into video_assets.

nodes.name: V2 — SRT Parse
nodes.notes: Parses DJI SRT telemetry (GPS, altitude, ISO, etc.) into video_assets.

nodes.name: V3 — QA
nodes.notes: Runs automated video QA checks. Updates qa_status in video_assets.

nodes.name: V4 — Proxy Gen
nodes.notes: Generates 1080p proxy files for DaVinci Resolve editing.

parameters.content:
V5 — Manual Edit

Operator opens DaVinci Resolve with proxy files.
This step is manual. The V6 export runs after editing is complete.

Trigger V6 via: POST /webhook/video-export-ready { mission_id }

nodes.name: Run Mapping?
nodes.notes: Route to Path C (photogrammetry via NodeODM) if this is a mapping package with photos.

parameters.content:
Path C — Photogrammetry (NodeODM)

Not yet implemented. Will POST photos to NodeODM (localhost:3000/task/new),
poll for completion, and drop orthomosaic.tif into E:\output\{mission_id}\mapping\.

Once Path C is built, connect it here and wire its completion to the
'Route to Path E?' node.

nodes.name: Route to Path E?
nodes.notes:
If vegetation_analysis is enabled AND mapping is running, fire Path E webhook.
Path E workflow will poll for the ortho to appear before starting E1.

nodes.name: Fire Path E Trigger
nodes.notes: POST to Path E webhook. Path E workflow will poll for Path C ortho before proceeding with E1-E4.

nodes.name: Build Response
nodes.notes: Returns routing summary as webhook response to ingest_sorter.py.

nodes.name: Delivery Webhook
nodes.notes:
Separate trigger for delivery packaging. Called after manual edit (V5) is done or when operator is ready to deliver.
Payload: { mission_id, mission_folder_path, include_vegetation: bool, include_mapping: bool }

nodes.name: Delivery — Package ZIP
nodes.notes: Runs delivery_packaging.py with --mission-id to auto-fetch address/city from Supabase. Outputs JSON with zip_path.

nodes.name: Delivery — Parse Result
nodes.notes: Parse delivery_packaging.py JSON output (zip_path, zip_name, counts, etc.).

nodes.name: Delivery — Upload to Drive
nodes.notes: Uploads delivery ZIP to Google Drive Sentinel_Deliveries/Active/ folder.

nodes.name: Set Status — Delivered
nodes.notes: Mark mission as delivered in Supabase after successful upload.

nodes.name: Delivery Response
nodes.notes: Returns delivery confirmation as webhook response.

_meta.description: Central routing brain for Sentinel pipeline. Receives ingest webhook, looks up processing template, routes to video chain (V1-V4), mapping (Path C), and vegetation analysis (Path E).

routing_logic.video_chain: V1 (color grade) → V1.5 (metadata) → V2 (SRT parse) → V3 (QA) → V4 (proxy gen) → V5 (manual edit) → V6 (format export)
routing_logic.mapping: Path C (NodeODM photogrammetry) — placeholder, not yet implemented
routing_logic.vegetation: Path E (fires webhook to separate Path E workflow) — requires mapping to also be running

ingest_payload_schema.mission_folder_path: string (absolute path to ingested mission folder)
